text: 💡 Sassafras. The small tree with mitten-shaped leaves (three shapes), spicy root smell you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
💡 You see it again in your mind: a vine with thick-skinned round fruit. Larry's words land on the memory like a label. Muscadine Grapes. Of course.
💡 You see it again in your mind: a tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps. your teacher's words land on the memory like a label. White Oak Acorns. Of course.

💡 Hickory Nuts. The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Irving learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 3)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Speedbump: Never stand next to it. Don't step next to it — it can't chase, so just walk around. Keep two squares away and it's furniture. When it seals up, wait it out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
💡 The shrub with small oval leaves and clusters of bright red berries on bare twigs — THAT's what Larry was describing. Spicebush. It clicks like a key turning.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Ugly Beast: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
